### Bio:

Hi! I’m Wantong Li, a second-year master’s student in the MDSH program at UCLA. I’m interested in data analytics, machine learning, and risk modeling in public health, particularly how data-driven approaches can help identify health trends, improve decision-making, and support more equitable systems. Before UCLA, I studied Economics with a minor in Psychology at New York University. Outside of academics, I’m also interested in fashion, visual storytelling, and creative media.
